title: Fireblocks disputes report of $2.5B Visa acquisition talks
summary: Fireblocks told Cointelegraph that reports of a potential $2.5 billion acquisition by Visa are “not true at present time,” while Visa declined to comment on the reported talks.

title: CryptoQuant CEO calls rising Bitcoin hashrate ‘indirect bullish signal’ from institutions
summary: Public miners backed by major TradFi players are coming back online, boosting Bitcoin’s hashrate, a positive sign for BTC’s fundamentals, according to CryptoQuant’s Ki Young Ju.

title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: Thailand SEC says several companies eye crypto ETFs, none has applied
summary: Thailand’s SEC says several asset managers have sought consultations on spot crypto ETFs, but it cannot confirm whether the first funds will launch in 2026.

title: SoFi unveils bank-issued tokenized deposit for yield-bearing crypto funds
summary: SoFi Bank launched SoFi Earn, a tokenized deposit paying 4.40% APY with FDIC coverage, allowing users to convert funds to stablecoins 24/7.

title: Bitcoin ETF buyers are trend followers, not setters, DWF Labs says
summary: DWF Labs research finds that Bitcoin ETF flows follow past BTC price movements rather than predict future returns, with investors buying rallies and selling dips.

title: The UK needs a workable route to regulated DeFi access
summary: The UK’s 2027 crypto rules risk a de facto ban on regulated firms providing access to DeFi, argues Coinbase’s European policy head Katie Harries.

title: CoinDCX admits ‘operational losses’ after $16M wallet transfers draw scrutiny
summary: CoinDCX said it covered losses caused by a failed transfer process involving compromised wallets and credited all affected user accounts.

title: Bitcoin corrects below $82K after Tesla Q3 results, KOSPI falls
summary: Bitcoin reversed a run toward $85,000 after Tesla reported lower-than-expected capital expenditure in Q3.

title: Starknet voters back research into life beyond Ethereum
summary: StarkWare plans to release a draft whitepaper in November as it explores an independent, quantum-resistant blockchain.
